tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kye rdo rje'i bsnyen pa bya tshul zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang bcas pa thub bstan gling bzhi mdzes par byed pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru he badzra yā/ brtan g.yo kun khyab zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag bi ru pa/ /de gsung man ngag mdzod 'dzin snying po'i mtshan/ /gang gi rigs sras rje btsun mched kyi zhabs/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan paṇḍi ta/ /sa gsum 'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / /bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pas spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam rgyud sde'i bcud/ /'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong bzhed pa'i gzhung / /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi nyams bzhes gtso/ /dges pa rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub bya ba'i tshul/ /'khrul zad 'jam mgon 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po dang / sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mched kyi phyag len dang / /gsung ngag dag las yang yang thos pa rnams/ /thun mong ma yin gsal bar bris 'di la/ /bstan srung mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod/ /de yang 'dir dpal kye rdo rje'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ thog mar bla ma dam pa zhig la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dmigs khrid la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa thob cing / dam tshig dang ldan pas/ lam dus kyi dbang thob pa nas bzung ste bsnyen pa nam byed bar la/ rab lam dus thun bzhi/ 'bring thun gsum/ tha na'ang lam dus rgyas pa re te 'bring po re te thun gnyis gal srid thun gnyis chag tshe dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i bla ma zhig la/ slar lam dbang zhus nas/ de'i dgong nas brtsams thun gnyis ma chag par byas la/ nges par ma chag par byas la/ de bsnyen pa la 'jug par bya ba la/ rje btsun rin po ches/

lam 'bras kyi man ngag las/ bsnyen pa bya tshul/ rab 'bring dgur gsungs te/ de yang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rab 'bring gsum ni/ rab yi dam gyi lha las dngos su gnang ba thob pa/ 'bring rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la 'jog nus pa/ tha ma rmi lam du gnang ba thob pa/ 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa rab 'bring gsum ni/ rab lo drug 'bring zla ba drug tha ma zhag bdun yin no/ /tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa la rab 'bring gsum ste/ rab gtso bo la bzhi 'bum/ 'khor la bzhi khri/ 'bring gtso bo la bzhi khri/ 'khor la bzhi stong / tha ma gtso bo la bzhi stong / 'khor la bzhi brgya yin no/ /dus dang grangs kyi 'bring dang tha ma gnyis kyi ni bsnyen pa kha gso ba las dngos gzhi'i bsnyen pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ rje btsun rtse mos dbang chur gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ rdo rje dril bu nam mkhar 'jog pa rab kyi nang du bsdus nas/ 'bring rmi lam du gnang ba thob pa/ tha ma nyams kyi snang ba la 'drir rung ba dang / dus kyi bsnyen pa la/ rab zla ba drug 'bring zla ba gsum zhes gsungs pa las/ 'dir dus bsnyen rab bam 'bring po dang / grangs bsnyen rab 'gro ba la dgongs te/ zla ba drug tu las dang po pa rnams kyis rang dbang bsdus shing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa zhig tu bya dgos te/ 'khor lo sdom pa las/ gnas ni rtag par bya ba dang / /yid ni gang du dga' ba'i sa/ /zhes dang rje btsun sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dang po rang gi khyim du bsgom/ /brtan pa thob nas dur khrod sogs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pas na/ gzhi bdag gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa ma yin pa'i/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas khang ngam/ bla ma gong ma'i sgrub gnas byin rlabs can la sogs par/ 'byor na kye rdo rje'i bris sku'am/ 'bur sku byin rlabs can dang / gur lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa la sogs pa'i chos skyong gi sku rnams gnas khang dang bstun pa'i zhal shar ram lhor phyogs par bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du/

stegs bang rim can la ras la sogs pa gzhi bzang po bkab pa'i steng du 'bru'i gcal bkram zhing / 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma dam rdzas zlum gtor gyis kyang rung mod/ 'dir gtor kha gso bde ba la dgongs pa yin no/ /glang ru ma bdun tshar ram/ lnga tshar/ gsum la sogs pa stegs mtho bar bzhag bskang ba'i gtor ma rgyas bkram bskangs/ bsdus bsdus bskangs/ gnyis 'byor pa dang bstun nas de'i mdun nam mjug lta bur bzhag de'i mdun du chu gnyis sam bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga yang bkod/ dus rgyun du dgong thun rjes la 'bul rgyu'i thun gtor gru gsum bzhi chang bu dang bcas pa'ang bshams shing / gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs shing / gu gul gyi dud pas bdug gtor kha gso srod tho rangs snga dro'i thun gsum la dam rdzas kyi gtor ma gang yod rnams gso/ dgong thun la bskang gtor rnams kyang gsos/ ba'i dus ma gtogs bsgul bskyod mi byed/ rang nyid 'dug sar sngas stan nang tshang can la sogs pa bshams shing / phyis nas bcos kha bya mi dgos par snga mo nas lhus thing par byas pa'i mdun nam/ ji ltar 'os par stegs shig la/ rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab la/ 'thor nas la sogs pa bshams shing / 'phreng ba ni/ rab de nyid bdun dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos pa las/ 'dir ni las thun mong ba'i dbang du byas te/ dang po phreng ba'i rgyu ni/ bo dhi tsitta dang thod pa'i phreng ba ste/ saṃ ṭi las/ zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las/ /bo dhi tsis ni las kun byed/ /ces dang / rtsa ba'i sngags las kyang / ka pā la mā la/ zhes sogs te/ thod pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa zhes 'byung ba dang / glo bo mkhan chen gyis kyang de ltar du gsungs shing / gnyis pa grangs ni/ brgya dang bcu gcig nges par du bya dgos te/

'di'i nang du las bzhi ka'i 'phreng ba'i grangs tshang ba dang / khyad par sngags kyi kha skong gi grangs kyang zhor la 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod pas so/ /zhes 'khrul zad 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyi gsung las thos pa'o/ /gsum pa 'phreng thag ni/ ras bal la sogs pa gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i srid bu dgu bsgril du bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yang na ras bal skud pa ni/ /zhes dang / gzhon nu ma yis bkal ba yis/ /de yang gzugs mdzes lus rdzogs shing / /gtsang zhing dri ldan snyan par smra/ /de yis bkal ba'i phreng thag gis/ /grol ba'i dngos grub skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs zhing / saṃ ṭi las kyang / phyogs dang mtshams ni brgyad rnams kyi/ /dbus su dgu pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /lha dgu la sogs srad bu la/ /lha dgus byin gyis brlab par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa mdo 'dzin ni nyis brtsegs byas pa'i 'og ma ye shes stobs sogs dang / gong ma chos dbyings mtshon pa ste/ saṃ ṭi las/ 'phreng ba kun gyi dgra bcom pa/ /mchod rten steng du rab tu brtag /mchod rten chos kyi phung po'i phyir/ /steng du yang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa rgyu ba'i tshul ni/ 'phreng thag dgra bcom par mos te/ /'phreng ba sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /lag pa g.yon pas 'phreng ba bzung / /g.yas pas 'phreng thag rgyu zhing / ngag tu hūm̐ brjod cing / thabs shes zung du 'brel bar sgom zhing rgyu ba ste/ saṃ ṭi las/ ā li kā li'i sa bon ni/ /hūm̐ gi srad bu rgyu ba nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /drug pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ saṃ ṭi las/ 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad gtso/ /zhes pa ni spyi 'gro'i dbang du gsungs la/ 'dir ni rang nyid kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams padma 'dab ma lnga dang / lag mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a li bcu drug g.yon du bskor ba'i lte ba la a/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga rdo rje rtse lnga pa/

lag pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams kyis g.yas su bskor ba'i lte bar hūm̐ bsams la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas 'phreng ba blangs te/ lag pa gnyis kyi dbus su bzhag la/ ngag tu/ bdud rtsi'i yi ge suṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje dang padma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems suṃ la khyab/ des a li ka li la khyab/ de 'phreng ba dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dzñā naṃ/ sarba buddha ma yaṃ bha wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di thog mar byin gyis rlob dus 'phreng skor gcig bzlas/ phyis nas dag pa dran pa rdzogs 'phral gsum la sogs pa bzlas nas bzlas pa dngos la zhugs pas nus mthu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rje btsun rtse mos gsungs/ bdun pa bgrang ba'i tshul ni/ las bzhi dang mthun par rim bzhin mdzub mo/ gung mo/ srin lag mthe'u chung rnams kyi steng nas 'phreng ba 'ong bar byas la/ mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyur bsams nas/ dngos grub gang yin pa 'gugs par bsam pa ste/ saṃ ṭi las/ mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyu las/ /dngos grub la ni dgug par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / de nas mdo 'dzin bar du bgrangs/ mdo 'dzin la mi 'gom par skor ba byed pa'i tshul gyis bgrang ste/ saṃ ṭi las/ sor mo la sogs bye brag la/ /phyis ni sngags pas bzla bar bya/ /zhes mdor bstan nas/ zhi la khro bor dgod par bya/ /rgyas la dbus ma'i de nyid la/ /srin lag la ni dbang du gsungs/ /kun gyi mthar ni mngon spyod la/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'o na lag pa g.yas g.yon gang gis bgrang na/ 'dir saṃ ṭi las/ g.yon pa rdo rje can gyi dngos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lag pa g.yon rdo rjer bsams nas bgrang ba ni/ ma rgyud pa'i g.yon gyi kun spyod gtso che ba la dgongs so/ /de ltar phreng ba'i kun rdzob dang /

don dam pa'i de kho na nyid shes pas/ sngags bzlas na dngos grub 'grub cing / gzhan du na 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ saṃ ṭi las/ mnyam gzhag bzlas dang bsgom pa yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nyid med pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de nyid med pa'i sngags zlos dang / /rdo rje dril bu'i de nyid med/ /phyag rgya'i de nyid skye mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pa yis de nyid dmigs/ /de nyid thams cad byed pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pas na/ 'phreng ba'i de nyid rnams tshang ba gal che ba lags/ rgyas par ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis sbyor ba'i chos mdor bsdus tsam song nas/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i mar ngo'i gza' skar bzang ba zhig gi dgong mo/ gnas khang gi phyi sgor tho dkar po legs pa zhig brgyab la/ mtshams g.yog gcig gnyis sogs gang dgos snga mo nas mtshams 'og tu bcug de rnams ma gtogs gzhan yong du mi 'jug go /dgos pa chen po'i dbang gis lha rje la sogs pa mi 'phrad kha med rang byung na/ phyag len la sgo'i phyi rol tu mtshams g.yog pas gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs la/ mtshams 'og tu 'jug snyam pa bya zhing / sngags kyi grangs nam song gi bar du gdan thog 'di kha rang du 'dug snyam pa dang / zla ba 'di dang 'di la 'gro ba gcig nges par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa snga mo nas dung dung mi bya/ khyad par 'di'i skabs su gang byung yang bla ma mkhyen snyam pa'i sgo nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa gal che/ des na bsnyen pa byed pa la/ mgo lhod pa/ sgang la grim pa/ mjug lhod pa ste mdor na nas 'dra'i tshul du nyams su blang dgos pas/ thog ma nas dang / khams dwangs pa'i skabs rnams su nus nus po mi bya bar snyoms par bya zhing / de yang thun gsum mam/ bzhir bya ba gnyis/ dang po thun gsum du bya ba 'di ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ thun gsum du byin brlabs nas bsgoms pa rnam par sgom nas langs te lha'i gzugs su bzhag go

/zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ 'dir ni/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa'i lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgom pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'gag cing 'tshang rgya bar gsal bas bshad rgyud/ ces gsungs pa ltar man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyi phyag len la thun bzhir mdzad pas/ de'i tshul ni/ thun gyi mgo dgong thun nas 'dzin cing / snga thun la grol bar mdzad pas/ dgong thun dang tho rangs gyi thun la lam dus rgyas pa dang / srod dang snga dro'i thun la lam dus 'bring po mdzad pas/ lam dus rgyas 'bring gnyis go sgyur ba'i bzhed pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor 'di tho rangs dang srod thun la nges par bya dgos te/ tho rangs bdud dpa' bkong ba dang / srod la bdud btul nas sangs rgyas pa dang chos mtshungs pas/ sngon byung dang mthun pa la dgongs pas so/ /lam dus 'bring po 'di la kha cig ni/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rab ma mthong zhing / bla ma dam pa'i gsung ngag sogs las thos bsam gyi sbyangs pas rgyang ring du dben nas/ bag chol du gyur pa'i rang gzhan 'khrul par spyod pa zhig mthong bas/ 'dir bla ma'i gsung rgyun phyag len bzhin brjod na/ thog mar phyi dkyil gyi skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gnyis mi bya bar/ oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces pa'i rjes la/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes sogs brjod/ dur khrod rgyas pa mi byed par/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ ces sogs sta gon bzhin brjod/ de nas lus dkyil gyi dbang lha spyan drangs nas/ dkar mo ri dwags kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rjes bstod nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun sogs kyis gsol ba btab la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che sogs shlau ka gcig gi mjug tu/

de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du sogs rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /sogs shlau ka gcig gi mjug tu/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba sogs kyi rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sogs shlau ka gcig gi mjug tu/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i sogs rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /sogs shlau ka gcig gi mjug tu/ de ltar na don dam pa sogs rtogs bskyed tshar ba dang / de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang / zhes sogs man rgyas pa dang 'dra bar bya ba ste/ lam dus 'bring po bya tshul bla ma'i gsung rgyun 'khrul pa med pa bkod pa'o/ /de nas thog mar sngon 'gro gsum la zhag gsum gsum bya ste/ sngon 'gro rgyas na dngos gzhi la gnod pas 'di tsam bya ba'am/ rgyas par 'dod na zhag lnga bdun dgu la sogs pa gang 'os shes par bya'o/ /sngon 'gro gsum gyi bzlas pa'i skabs su aṣṭa 'phreng skor gsum tsam re bgrang zhing / 'di yang 'og gi sngags kyi grangs lam rtsi zhes bla ma'i gsung las thos so/ /de'i tshul la/ dang po ni/ skyabs yul rnams gsal gdab pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro thun bsdud ma ran gyi bar la gang 'gro byas nas/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa lus dkyil dang bcas pa rgyas 'bring gnyis ka'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya zhing / khyad par du srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mtshams ma grol gyi bar du mi bsdu ba gnad du che zhes bla ma dam pa rnams gsung ngo / /de'i tshul ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la zhes sogs bya'o/ /srod tho rangs snga dro gsum gyi thun mjug tu gtor bsngo 'bring po mdzad pas/ de'i tshul ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ

lan gsum gyi bar gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis kyai rdo rje'i gtor bsngo dang / de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ zhes pa nas/ hūm̐ dang bhyoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa zhes pa'i bar gyis lcam dral gnyis bskyed la/ mgon po'i g.yas su padma nyi ma/ zhes pa nas/ lnga ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi zhal bzhi pa dang / de nas/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las/ zhes pa nas/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐ ya maṃ triḥtriḥbhyoḥrnams las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi pho brang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas mgon po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum lha mo'i mkhar sogs nas lha mo/ te se/ bsil pa'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / kha'u'i brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las mgon pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ de nas/ hūm̐ mgon po kun gshegs sogs dang / lha mo kun gshegs sogs dang / sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi sogs dang / las mgon kun gshegs sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wī/ tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ sogs nas/ shapda pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā lī de wi sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥ bi shwa mu khe bhyeḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇa daṃ ba lyā da swāhā/

lnga'am bdun dang / sha sa na gsum dang / oṃ ro ru sogs lan gsum dang / oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi ka la ra tri ta ḍo bi nī tsaṇḍa lī rakkha si siṅga li de wi sa pa ri wa ra na ma sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes sogs lan gsum mam lnga dang / oṃ a li a li ma sogs bod sngags gnyis kyi mjug tu/ i daṃ bha liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trun bighnan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ sogs gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li dāe wi/ mahā kā la tsa turmu khā sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang / oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ ro ru sogs dang / oṃ mahā kā la kā la sogs zhal gyi sngags thung dang / oṃ badzra kā la yakṣa sogs kyi mjug tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul te/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes pa nas/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum dang / phaiṃ/ zhes pa nas/ 'phrin bcol gyi bar gyi mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ nas dge ba'i sdongs grogs ci nus mdzod kyi bar gyis gzhi bdag la gtor ma phul tshar rjes/ mgon po lha mo zhal gsum gyi sngags thung brjod nas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba po/ /sogs shlau ka gcig dang / dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti sogs shlau ka gcig dang / dpal ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur ba sogs shlau ka gcig dang / nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang sogs shlau ka gcig gi rjes su/ dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod nas/ oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /zhes pa man gtor bsngo rgyas pa bzhin bya'o/ /'di'i kha 'phang rnams dang phyag rgya dril bu dkrol lugs sogs gtor bsngo rgyas pa ltar shes par bya'o/

/dgong thun rjes su gtor bsngo rgyas pa sa los mdzad pa ltar nyams su blangs nas/ bskang gso mi shes shing byed par mi spro na ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med par sems/ de'i tshe gong gi bskang gtor dang thun gtor yang bsham mi dgos so/ /dril bsil bya tshul 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyi phyag len ltar brjod pa ni/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor ma la 'thor tshul byas la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs nas/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ gi bar gyi bskang rdzas byin rlabs bskang gsar ltar byas la/ tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu dril bu bsil zhing rdo rje g.yab la/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes 'phrin las kun/ /sogs sngags dang bcas pa'i spyan 'dren dang / dkar bdud kyi spyan 'dren bsdus pa'ang bya/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i sogs byon skyems sngags dang bcas pa brjod nas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ gtor sngags rnams tshar gsum gsum brjod nas/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ 'phrin bcol blo dang bstun nas brjod pa sogs bskang gsar ltar byas la/ rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ sku dang gsung thugs ma tshar gcig gam gsum brjod nas/ dril bu gsum brdung byas la/ mgon po lha mo zhal gsum gyi sngags thung brjod nas/ tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu dril bu bsil zhing rdo rje gsor la/ sangs rgyas bstan srung ma bsdus pas bstod la/ rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / oṃ lha yi tshogs sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar byas la/ de nas dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ kaulla e retṭhi sogs brjod nas/ tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu bsil la/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs nas/ de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi bar byas la/ de nas ḍā ma ru rgyun dkrol dal ba dang / dril bu gsum brdung bya zhing / dpal ldan mgon po mahā ka la dang /

/sogs nas/ dpon slob bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /zhes pa'i bar brjod cing / de nas ḍā ma ru dang dril bu drag myur dkrol la/ sdang ba'i dgra dang / zhes sogs nas gtor sngags dang 'phrin las 'chol ba'i bar gyi spyi btab kyi thun gtor rnams phul la/ tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu bsil nas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma shlau ka gsum brjod pa'i rjes su/ yi ge brgya pa sogs rjes chog rnams dkyus bzhin bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms la/ yi ge brgya pa thun bsdu ma ran bar du gang 'gro byas nas/ sngar bzhin lam dus kyi mjug gtor bsngo dang bcas pa bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsgoms nas/ uṣṇi ṣa thun bsdud ma ran bar gang 'gro byas nas/ sngar bzhin lam dus kyi mjug gtor bsngo dang bcas pa bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di'i skabs su lam dus 'bring po len skabs kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsgom dgos te/ zhes pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyi gsung las thos/ uṣṇi ṣa bzla dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun e waṃ pa rnams sngon 'gro bzhir byas te/ maṇḍal byed gsungs kyang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyis phyag len la mi mdzad pas 'dir ma bris so/ /dngos gzhi la/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa lam dus rgyas 'bring re mos bya zhing / de yang skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa la ma sleb kyi bar/ tshig dag cing bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs pa dang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sogs kyi gnad rnams kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅges mdzad pa'i man ngag rnam bshad du gzigs par zhu/ bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs pa so so gsal 'debs pa'i skabs su sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed ngo gang 'phrod byas shing / rdzogs rim bsgoms tshar ba dang / dag pa rjes su dran pa rgyas pa'am/

ma grub na bsdus pa ni nges par bya dgos te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rin chen gzi brjid 'bar ba yi/ /'phreng ba 'khrugs pa lha mo ltos/ /ma phugs pas ni sbyor bral gyur/ /phugs pas dga' ba sbyin pa po/ /de ltar 'khor ba 'dod pa yi/ /yon tan lnga ldan rin po che/ /ma dag pas ni dug tu 'gyur/ /dag pas bdud rtsi lta bur 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rje btsun rtse mos kyang / mchog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la ni dag pa dran pa khyad par gyi chos so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rab dag dran rgyas pa gang thub dang / bsdus pa tsam ni ma chad pa gal che'o/ /de'i rjes su sngar bshad pa'i phreng ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags gsum la sogs pa bzlas nas/ bzlas pa dngos gzhi la 'jug par bya ste/ de la gtso 'khor gyi sngags rim can du grangs bzung ba dang / gcig char du bzung ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dir 'jug pa bde ba la dgongs te/ rim can du grangs bzung ba 'di phyag len la mdzad pas/ thog mar rtsa ba'i sngags aṣṭa thun re la gang 'gro bgrang zhing / thun bsdud ran pa dang / snying po nye snying 'phreng sngags ang thung 'khor rnams kyi sngags bcu gcig tsam re bzlas la/ 'phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung ste kha rlangs 'phog par byas la rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing / bde bar gshegs pa sogs brjod la/ de'i rjes su yig mngon rtogs dang rnam bshad phal cher du ma gsungs kyang phyag len la mdzad/ brgya gsum bzlas nas dkyil 'khor bsdus la gtor bsngo sogs gong sngon 'gro'i skabs bzhin bya/ dngos gzhi tshugs nas/ sngon 'gro'i skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya dang uṣṇi ṣa rnams bsdus tsam bya ste/ rgyas na sngags thun la gnod pas so/ /'on kyang yi ge brgya pa ni nyung mtha' yang nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla dgos te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas/ /ltung sogs byin gyis brlabs 'gyur bas/

/'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya/ /'bum phrag dag ni bzlas gyur na/ /rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /thun mtshams rnams su chag med gzhan dgos pa rnams ma chag tsam re bya zhing / chos dang mthun pa'i spyod pas ci bder rgyu ba dang / tho rangs kyi thun bsdus mtshams su/ yan lag lnga sbyong ngam/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa la sogs pa lus sbyong rgyas bsdus gang rigs sam/ 'phrin las so gnyis kyi 'khrul 'khor la brtson par bya ba'am/ mi shes sam gnas khang byar mi rung ba rnams su skor ba la brtson par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la gsum ste/ 'khor ba'i bzlas pa/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa/ bkod pa'i bzlas pa/ dang po ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ rang gtso bo yab yum du bsgom pa'i yum gyi thugs ka'i aṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung / yum gyi zhal nas thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste padmar zhugs nas yum gyi sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi zhal nas thon par bsgom zhing rgyun mi 'chad par 'khor ba la dmigs la bzlas pa bya'o/ /sngags kyi kha dog ni/ zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po'am sngon po/ rgyun gyi bzlas pa thams cad sdig pa zhi ba'i phyir dkar po bya/ dbang bskur ba'i bsnyen pa byed na/ lha dbang du bsdud pas dmar por bsam/ rab gnas kyi bsnyen pa byed na bsod nams rgyas pas ser por bsgom/ gzhan las gang byed pa de dang de'i kha dog dang mthun par bya'o/ /'khor rnams kyi sngags bzla skabs/ 'khor ba'i dmigs pa snga ma bzhin byas la/ sngags kyi 'od zer des lha mo gang gi bzlas pa byed pa'i lha mo de la phog pas/ de dbang du 'du zhing 'phrin las la bskul bar bsam la bzlas pa bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing /

rje btsun rin po ches/ bde mchog gi skabs su phar 'khor du gsungs shing / rje sa chen gyis/ rlung brtan par 'dod na tshur 'khor dang / byang sems brtan par 'dod na phar 'khor du bya bar gsungs pas/ dgos pa'i dbang gis gang 'dod par bya'o/ stod na ba la sogs pa byung na tshur 'khor dang / byang sems 'dzag pa la sogs pa byung na phar 'khor du bya dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags kyi yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lha'i rnam pa gsal gdab cing / mchod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas rang gi snying khar thim par bsam zhing zlos pa ste/ 'di rje btsun rtse mos tshogs 'khor la sogs pa'i dus su zlos pa'i man ngag tu bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ snying gar sngags kyi yig 'bru bkod nas de la dmigs nas klog pa'i tshul gyis bzlas so/ /de la bzla bar bya ba'i sngags dngos/ zlos pa'i go rim/ ji ltar bzla ba'i tshul/ ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs/ de ltar bzlas pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags te de la/ oṃ ni mchog ster ba'i don no/ /aṣṭa na nā ya brgyad pa'i zhal can/ piṃ gaurdha kai sha warta ma ne/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ tsa tur biṃ sha ti nai trā ya nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan can/ ṣa ḍa sha bhū dza ya bcu drug gi phyag can/ kṛṣṇa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe sku mdog char sprin ltar nag pa/ ka pā la mā la a nai kaṃ dha ri ṇe/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba du ma 'dzin pa/ atma tā kru ra tsitta ya ni bdag nyid kyi sems khong nas 'khrug pa/ ardhentu daṃṣṭi ṇe mche ba zla ba phyed pa lta bu can/ 'dir oṃ zhes pa mi thub zla ba'i ku mu ti dang / sgrub thabs gnyis char du med cing / rtsa rgyud kyi rgya dpe kha cig dang / sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ rin chen 'bar ba/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bshad pas/ de ltar na/ oṃ ni dam bca' ba'o/ /ma ra ya ma ra ya sod sod/

kā ra ya kā ra ya gyis gyis/ gardza ya gardza ya sgrogs sgrogs/ tardza ya tardza ya rtogs rtogs/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya skom skom/ gang skom na/ sapta sa ga rā ṇa/ rgya mtsho bdun/ bandha bandha chings chings/ gang chings na/ nā ga aṣṭa kan klu brgyad/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ zungs zungs/ gang zungs na/ sha trun/ dgra'o/ /ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥ zhes pa rnams ni yum gyi a li'i dod do/ /pho skad kyi yi ge ha la dbyangs bcu gnyis sbyar bas bzhad pa'i nyams bcu gnyis su 'gyur ba yin te/ gsang sngags kyi dngos gzhi lta bu yin no/ /zhes rje btsun gsungs so/ /phaṭ dgas pa/ swāhā gzhi tshugs pa ste rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ni sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ de wa zhes bya ba ni rol pa ste/ bde ba la rol bas lha'i sems kyi don la rol bar byed pa'o/ /pi tsu ni 'jam po ste/ ji ltar bal 'jam pos sbar sbur bsdud pa ltar/ 'di yi thugs rdo rje 'jam pos sems can thams cad bsdud pa'o/ /badzra zhes bya ba ni rdo rje mi phyed pa ltar shes rab stong pa nyid kyi don te ji ltar rdo rjes pha rol 'joms pa ltar thugs rdo rjes ma rung pa rnams 'joms pa'i don to/ /de bas na he badzra 'di ni chos gsum dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /hūm̐ gsum ni sku gsung thugs mi phyed pa ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ hūm̐ ni sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum 'byung ba/ /zhes so/ /phaṭ swāhā ni sngar bzhin te snying po'o/ /oṃ sngar bzhin/ badzra karta ri rdo rje gri gug he badzra ya kyai rdo rje'i bkas zhes te/ gri gug gis gzhan gcod pa ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa chod cig pa'o/ /hūm̐ gsum dang phaṭ swāhā ni sngar bzhin te nye ba'i snying po'o/ /yum dang 'khor rnams kyi sngags ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dbyangs bco lnga rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sa bon du bshad pa dang /

phyi ma'i lnga par/ aṃ yum gyi sa bon dang / gaṃ tsaṃ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon du bshad pa la/ dang po'i gnyis par/ sngags thams cad kyi rkang pa dang por oṃ gyi rnam pa dang / mthar ni swāhā dang hūm̐ phaṭ kyi rnam pa ni nang du gzhug go /zhes mgo bor oṃ dang / mjug tu phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa sbyor bar gsungs pa la brten nas/ rje btsun rtse mos 'khor rnams kyi sngags mdzad pa ni rgyud dang shin tu mthun no/ /de la/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ bdag med ma'i 'o/ /oṃ āḥgaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ gau rī'i 'o/ /zhes sogs gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /rgyas par spro na/ oṃ āḥgaṃ badzra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa sa bon gyi rtsa bar ming gzhug oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes sogs ji ltar 'os pa bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ oṃ āḥnaṃ badzra nai ratma ye hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa re brjod pa sogs lha mo brgyad char la'ang shes par bya'o/ /par byas la bzla 'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags gsum gyis sku gsung thugs bskul bar bshad pa ltar/ thog mar rtsa sngags bzla ste/ de ni sku skul byed du gsungs la/ sku de ni rags pa yin pas bskul sla ba'i phyir ro/ /gsung phra bas de'i rjes dang / thugs shin tu phra bas bskul dka' bas thams cad kyi rjes su bskul ba yin zhes bla ma gong ma dag gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ sngags kyi tshig ngag tu mi brjod par yid kyis zlos pas yid bzlas/ rlung bsdams nas yid kyi zlos pa 'gog pa'i bzlas pa/ rlung 'gro 'ongs dang sbyar nas bzlas pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ lce mi bde ba byung na sems gzhan du ma yengs pa'i sgo nas/ lce rtse dang mchu g.yo ba tsam gyis bzlas pa shub bu'i bzlas pa/ shes pa bying po byung na/ yi ge'i ring thung phyed cing skad gseng chen pos zlos pa rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i bzlas pa ste lnga yin no/

/bzhi pa ni/ aṣṭa la bzhi 'bum bzhi 'phreng ba la brgya dang bcu gcig yod na kha skong 'di rnams zhor la 'gro bas 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya/ de wa pi tsu la yang gong bzhin/ karta ri la bzhi khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya/ yum gyi 'phreng sngags la bzhi 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya sogs nges gzhan don byed pa la ni nges par bzhi 'bum bya dgos shing / gzhan ma bzhi 'bum gal srid ma thub tshe 'phreng sngags la bzhi khri dang / aṃ thung la bzhi 'bum sogs dgos pa 'dra snyam pa shar zhes sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las thos so/ /par bzla dgos pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyi gsung las gsal bar thos shing / 'dis ni bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i bsnyen pa yang song bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /aṃ thung dang lha mo brgyad la bzhi khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya rnams 'gro nges pa bya ba ni kha skong dang bcas pa yin pas thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len ltar bkod pa'o/ /'o na rtsa rgyud las/ 'khor lo'i bdag po bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor can gyi de bzhin khri/ /zhes gtso bo la 'bum dang / 'khor rnams la khri phrag re bzla bar bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ bod kyi bla ma rnams lung de ni rdzogs ldan gyi dus kyi dbang du byas la/ da lta rtsod dus yin pas de bzhi 'gyur du bya dgos te/ sdom 'byung las/ rdzogs ldan la ni bzla bya gcig /nyis 'gyur gsum ldan la bzla bya/ /gsum 'gyur gnyis ldan la rab brjod/ /rtsod ldan bzlas pa bzhi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas mi 'gal bar bzhed pa ni shin tu legs te/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dka' 'grel ye shes ldan las kyang / rdzogs ldan dus su yi ge 'bum bzlas te/ /gsum ldan dus kyi sngags pas 'bum phrag gnyis/ /gnyis ldan dus su 'bum phrag gsum du 'gyur/ /bye ba phrag gsum 'bum bzhi rtsod dus sbyar/

/zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ bzlas pas sangs rgyas kyi thugs bskul bas/ rang gis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo/ /mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags kyi snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa na/ /mngon sum du ni 'ong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs kun gshegs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang ltar gong du bshad pa'i don rnams nges par byas nas/ aṣṭa la grangs song ba dang / aṣṭa nyer gcig tsam re bgrangs nas de wa pi tsu la grangs 'dzin pa sogs rim pa bzhin grangs song ba rnams nyer gcig tsam re bzla zhing / ma song ba rnams la go rim bzhin grangs bzung ba ni rim can du grangs bzung ba'o/ /yang gnyis pa ni/ gcig car du grangs bzung bar 'dod na/ thun re la aṣṭa stong phrag gcig song na/ de wa pi tsu dang yum gyi 'phreng sngags gnyis kyang stong phrag re re bzla zhing / karta ri dang aṃ thung lha mo brgyad kyi sngags rnams brgya brgya bzla ba ni/ gtso bo la grangs gang song ba'i bcu cha'i don yin zhing / 'di ni nyi tshod grib tshod 'phyug pa med pa dang / gzugs bzang ba la de bzhin byas pas gtso 'khor rnams gcig char du 'gro ba yin yang las dang po pa la snga ma bde'o/ /gang ltar 'dis 'grub bam mi 'grub snyam du the tshom mi bya bar nges par 'grub snyam du bya zhing / sngags de yang rang gi zhal brgyad ka nas gsung ba dang / 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyis ram 'degs kyi tshul gyis gsung bar bsam zhing / sgra ci grags pa thams cad kyai rdo rje'i gsung gi rang bzhin rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sogs su byas te bzla ba ni bla ma'i man ngag go /mtshams kyi skabs 'dir rmi lam dang nyams snang 'tshub pa 'dra yong srid kyang skrag pa'i snang ba mi bya ste/ bogs yong ba yin/ thun nam grol bar ngag bcad bya zhing /

dgos pa khyad par can byung tshe/ sam po ra la yi ge bri ba'am/ brda bya/ kha cig kha'i phyed la lag pa bkab nas smra ba dang / so bsgrigs nas rang rang so so'i yul gyi skad cha'i gleng mo sogs byed pa zhig 'dug pas/ de 'dra ni spre'u'i rkun ma dang mtshungs pas spang bar bya'o/ /zhes bla ma'i gsung las thos so/ /'di'i skabs rnams su shes pa yang dub pa'i rnam pas bying nas gnyid bro mo byung na rig pa la ngar bskyed cing / sngags kyang sgra dum pa dang bcas bzla/ skad ches na 'gro chung zhing bar chad snang / des kyang ma phan na 'chi ba mi rtag pa ston pa'i dpe gzhan la dum re blta/ gzhan thun mtshams sogs gang du yang dpe cha gzhan la lta ba spang / mi so ma dang / zas so ma dang / lhag par dgon pa lta bur 'dug nas/ de'i mang ja gdan non sogs kyi skal ba 'byung ba'i tshe/ lce mi bde ba dang / gnyid du 'gro ba dang / g.yer ba la sogs pa 'byung nyen yod de/ de yang sngon la/ byung ba de cung zad yang ba yin/ dngos po de rnams lag tu sleb pa dang sang 'gro zhing / rting la byung na cung zad lci ba yin pas/ yi ge brgya pa dang / srung 'khor gnyis la brtson par bya ba dang / khyad par chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba la nan tan bskyed par bya'o/ /gzhan yang grub cing shes na/ bcu bzhi/ nyer dgu/ tshes brgyad/ nyer gsum rnams la chos skyong gi bskang gso skabs su gang bab re thub na legs shing / sngags thun la gnod tshe ma byas kyang 'gal ba cher med/ 'di skabs su/ rtsa khams dwangs pa'i stobs kyis tshig bcad 'dra rtsom 'dod pa la sogs bya ba gzhan byed 'dod pa yong bas/ de 'dra byung na bar chad kyi rgyur 'gro bas rtog pa de'i 'phro rbad bcad nas/ bla ma mkhyen snyam pa'i sgo nas/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa la sems hril te sgril nas bzhag yang mi nus pa'i rnam pa byung na/ grub thob gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar la bsam mno stong zhing /

khams dwangs pa dang lce bde ba'i dus 'gro chen po byung na/ mgyogs po 'gro ba 'dug snyam pa'i dga' spro chen po mi bya ste/ bar chad kyi rgyur 'gro ba yin/ yang skabs re tsa na mi bde ba chen po byung na/ bla ma la gsol ba btab cing / shes pa lhod kyis glod la/ khams la 'phrod pa'i bza' btung la nan tan byas pas sel lo/ /mtshams kyi skabs 'dir bza' btung gang byed pa rnams che chung dang mang nyung med pa dus rgyun du bya dgos te/ khams bde ba dang / khyad par bshang gci 'dor ba yang nges pa can du 'byung bas snyoms par bya'o/ /de ltar gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags kyi grangs rnams legs par song nas/ de'i rjes su/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang ba dang / rang gi sdig pa dang bar chad zhi ba'i phyir dang / gsang sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir ram/ sngags ma grub pa grub par byed pa dang / grub pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'byin par bya ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nges par bya dgos te/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing / /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes dang / sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim/ /tshim par gyur nas dngos grub ster/ /gsang sngags lhag chad gang yin pa/ /thams cad sbyin sreg dag gis skong / /de phyir rdo rje mkha' 'gro yis/ /sbyin sreg rab tu bsngags par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pas/ de'i tshul ni/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyi gsung rgyun phyag len ltar gsal bar brjod na/ gnas khang de nyid dam/ gzhan du yang rung bas/ sngags lhag chad kha skong ba'i skabs 'dir nyi ma gsum du mdzad pas/ dus rgyun du lam dus thun bzhi chag med dka' bas/ thun gnyis ma tsam mdzad tshe 'di nyin snga dro lam dus 'bring po bya'o/ /nyi ma dang po'i phyi srod la tshugs nas thun gcig dang / nyi ma bar pa la rgyas pa thun gnyis/ nyi ma gsum pa'i snga dro rgyas pa/

thun gcig rnams mdzad pas/ de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba thab dang bud shing sbar ba me/ /rdzas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa po ste drug /ces pa ltar las/ dang po thab ni/ nyams dga' zhing sa'i dpal ldan sa skya lta bu ni/ sa chog sngar grub pas bya mi dgos shing / ma byas pa'i sa phyogs su ni bsdus pa tsam nges par bya dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dus mtha'i cho gar gsungs pa ltar lag len bde'o/ /cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs su/ thig chen brgyad spyi tshangs thig dang po la che chung gi tshad skum khru gang gi tshad dbus nas g.yas g.yon du rtags byas la/ phyi'i gru bzhi'i nang du sor bzhi'i tshad kyi cha kha gru bzhir btab/ dang mthun par btab pa la/ khru phyed kyi dbus nas zlum por bskor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi rol tu sor bzhi bskor ba kha khyer dang / slar yang sor bzhi bskor ba mu ran dang / de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi'i tshad kyi cha kha gru bzhir mdzad pa ni bri cha la mig sngar mdzes pa dang / sgom don la stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad yin gsungs/ thab kyi dbus nas gsum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba la padma'i lte ba dang / phyi'i gsum gnyis la padma'i 'dab ma bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog dkar por bya/ kha khyer ram mu ran gang rung la rdo rje kha zum pa'i 'phreng bas bskor zhing / kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spangs pa'i phyir/ bcad tshon thams cad dang rdo rje kha dog dmar skyas bya/ lha'i gnas rnams su me tog gi tshom bu'am/ so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung bya/ de yang gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan pa'i mdun ngos su gau rī'i mtshan ma byas la/

de'i rigs pas gzhan rnams kyi phyogs mtshams kyang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsher ma can ma yin pa'i shing ngam/ de med na srog chags med pa'i lci bas thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs la nang gi 'jig rten pa'i shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba zhig kyang bshams la bzhag go /gsum pa sbar ba me ni/ rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gi me'am/ 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o/ /bzhi pa rdzas ni/ sreg rdzas dang / mchod rdzas dang / gtor ma dang / ku sha'i chun po brgyad la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o/ /lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la/ dri bzang pos byugs/ de'i mdun du rang gi stan nang tshang can kha dog dkar po bya zhing / sgrub grogs gzhan yod na/ de dag gi stan ji ltar 'os par bting zhing / rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas su nub nas shar du rim pa bzhin/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / stegs ji ltar rigs pa la/ dam rdzas kyi gtor ma lnga'am gsum mam gcig la sogs pa dang / bskang gso byed na/ bskang gtor yang bshams shing / ji ltar rigs par me lha la 'bul ba'i zlum gtor dkar gtor gcig kyang bsham mo/ /rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du nub nas shar du rim bzhin/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dūr ba ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham/ /zhes pa ltar/ yam shing nam phyag len la rgyu lcang dkar/ rje btsun rin po ches shug pas kyang rung bar bshad/ sbom phra mthe bong ngam/ mthe'u chung tsam la ring thung khru skum khru/ gang pa'am/ sor brgyad pa ste rtse mo gnyis mar ram sbrang rtsi la sbags pa/ de nas mar bshams par gsung yang / mar mi 'khyag pa'i phyir me la nye bar bzhag de nas til nag po'am yungs kar/

zas mchog ni zho la phye mar sbyar ba/ 'bras so ba/ 'bras ma chag pa/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūr ba/ phyag len la ram pa'i rtsa bas mdzad/ ku sha ma 'byor na 'jag ma ku shas mdzad/ rnams te/ yam shing dang ku sha ni thog mtha' gnyis su 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod skabs dang me lha lhag mas mchod skabs/ bdun nam nyer gcig gzhan dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'bul rgyu bcu gcig pa tshan pa bcu gcig rnams ras skud la sogs pas bsdams grangs mi nor zhing lag len bde ba yong / shing / logs shig tu rdzas de rnams kha gso chas kyang bkod la/ 'bul tshan re song ba dang yam shing dang ku sha tshan pa re rang rang gi gnas su bzhag cing / sreg rdzas gzhan rnams kha gso/ rang gi mdun du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba ni bsang chu/ ku sha'i 'thor g.yab/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar la bzhag so sor bzhag na bar chad kyi chos yin gsungs/ grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa la/ gangs ri dang chu ris dang wam̐ yig bris la/ gong gi rdzas rnams la nang mchod nas gtor la bzhag drug pa sgrub pa po ni/ rang 'dod lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /las kun byed pa'i sbyin sreg ste/ /tshad dang dbyibs dang kha dog dang / /zhi ba dang mthun shar du blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa rnams khrus byas la 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la/ sdig pa dang bar chad zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha 'jig rten pa'i shar du bltas te/ phyag len bde bas 'di ltar mdzad/ skyil krung sam pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i tsog bu rkang gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang / /thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod/

/'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug pa lus dkyil dang bcas pa gzhung bsrang la/ bzlas pa bsdus/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs kyi mjug tu/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdugaspos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes nang mchod phul/ thal mo sbyar la/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis snod bcud dang dkyil 'khor rim gyis bsdus la/ yum yab la thim/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim ste/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur par bsam/ 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyi phyag len la/ lag pa pus mo'i phyir 'das kyang nyes pa cher med lags/ ngag bcad ni nges par bya dgos shing / chab sang nam dgos la phyir phyin pas chog pa sogs phyag len 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir mdzad pa yin gsungs so/ /gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te/

rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pa'i lag pa gnyis kas gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing ngag tu/ de wa pi tsu lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la ram̐/ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar la me gso/ de nas khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyangs pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blugs gzar gyi mar bud shing la khyab par blug ste/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu la/ a mṛ ta'am/ hūm̐ ring po 'ba' zhig brjod pas/ rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la/ sngags de gnyis gang rung brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyis thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang gtor byas te bgegs bsal la/ sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams/ swā bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhās yam shing / oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ oṃ dzīṃ swāhās 'bru/ oṃ swa swāhās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā zhes sogs mchod pa rnams kyang so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs 'di 'og tu bshad kyang phyag len la 'dir mdzad pa cho ga zor yang ba'i ched yin no/ /bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'dus bya ba ni/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/

kha khyer ram mu ran la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol tu stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo/ /lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ raṃ las bgrang 'phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang 'phreng / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa'am/ yang na/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas mchog sbyin dang bgrang 'phreng / g.yon dbyug gu dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor gtsug can ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyi skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa man ngag lugs kyi skabs su 'dir mdzad/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bo gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkag pa dbyug gu rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ agna ye mahā te dzaḥ sarba karma pra sā da ka mahā bhū ta de wa ri ṣi dwī dza sa ta ma/ gṛ hī dwā ā hu tiṃ ā ha ra/ asmin san ni/ hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod la thab tu me tog gcig phul te/

thab kyi shar lhor padma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ zhes sogs kyis chu bzhi phul la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcings pa'am/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu bzung la/ oṃ badzra a na la mahā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmī ku ru sarba duṣṭan hūm̐ phaṭ/ traṃ shya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ badzra gau rī a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs bzhi phyag rgya dang bcas pa'am/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍākkis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ blo khog chung bas gong du ting nge 'dzin gyi me sbar la skabs 'dir dngos su sbar zhes gsungs kyang lag len snga ma bde'o/ /de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam ste/

oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig oṃ badzra satwa a/ zhes re re brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du bkram mo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdengs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsams/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsam ste/ oṃ agna ye swāhā zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ agna ye ā dī bya mahā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam mo/ /de ltar lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la/ bar 'dir me bkra brtag ste/ yang dag pa sbyor ba las byung pa rtogs sla ba'i phyir tshigs bcad du brjod na/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rdo rje dang / /bum pa padma lcags kyu dang / /sku gsum pa dang g.yas su 'khyil/ /rtse gcig pa ste dbyibs mchog yin/ /rtse gnyis rtse gsum 'bring dang tha/ /snum dang gtsang dang dbang po'i gzhu/ /dbang po sbas dang ser dang dkar/ /baiḍūrya rnams mdog bzang yin/ /ngang pa'i sgra dang bung ba'i sgra/ /zab cing snyan pa'i sgra ni bzang / /mdor na yid du 'ong ba yi/ /dbyibs dang dri dang mdog rnams bzang / /me stag 'phro dang du ba mang / /rim gyis 'bar zhing me lce mched/ /myur du 'bar zhing gzi brjid chung / /tshang zhing dmar nag drag tu 'bar/ /rtse gsum gzhib ma 'dra ba dang / /ba glang mgo 'dra dri mi zhim/ /mdor na yid du mi 'ongs pa/ /mtshan ngan rnams kyang brtag par bya/ /zhi ba dkar dang rgyas pa ser/ /dbang la dmar po drag la gnag /'di ni rang rang rtags su bzang / /'jam po gsum la 'jam po yi/

/rtags rnams shis par bshad pa ste/ /tha ma'i las la ngan pa bsngags/ /rang rang rtags dang mi mthun na/ /bgegs dang bcas par shes byas te/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la sogs pa'i/ /khro bos bgegs rnams zhi ba bya/ /zhes dang / mdor bsdus na/ kha dog dkar zhing snum pa sgra cung zad dang bcas pa/ dud pa chung ba ni zhi ba'i las la dge'o/ /du ba che ba dang / me stag rab tu 'phro ba ni bgegs dang bcas ngan pa yin pas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod la/ yam shing la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i sreg rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin lag pa g.yon du bzung / g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blangs shing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang / yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ boddhi bṛkṣa ya swāhā/ zhes pas bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ boddhi bṛkṣa ya bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang / sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang de'i rigs pas shes par byas la/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra yā swāhā/ zhes pas til lam yungs dkar dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang / oṃ badzra bi dzā ya swāhās 'bras so ba dang / oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhās 'bras dang / oṃ mahā be ga ya swāhās nas dang / oṃ badzra ghasma rā ya swāhās gro dang / oṃ mahā ba la ya swāhās sran ma dang / oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhās dur ba dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhās ku sha rnams phul la sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar ro/ /go rim 'di rnams sreg rdzas bshams pa'i skabs su gsungs pa'i go rim bzhin byas pa yin pas de'i skabs su bshad pa'i sdom tshig blo la nges pa gal che'o/

/de ltar me lha la bsreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ oṃ prokṣa ṇa pra titstsha swāhā zhes pas bsang gtor dang / oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā zhes pas zhabs bsil phul la mar blugs gzar gang thab du blugs te/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes sogs kyis srung 'khor thun mong sgrub thabs ltar gsal btab/ spro na/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa nas/ gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhes pa nas/ nub byang du thags bzang ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ ces pa'i bar brjod cing gsal gdab/ de nas hūm̐ shrī he badzra na maḥ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje zhes sogs dang / naṃ nai rātma na maḥ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma zhes sogs kyis gtso bo yab yum bskyed/ de bzhin du/ gaṃ gau rī na maḥ shar du gau rī nag mo sogs dang / tsaṃ tsau rī na maḥ lhor tsau rī dmar mo༞baṃ bai ta lī na maḥ nub tu bai ta lī ser mo༞ ghaṃ ghasma rī na maḥ byang du ghasma ri ljang khu༞ paṃ pukka sī na maḥ byang shar du pukka sī sngon mo༞ shaṃ sha wa rī na maḥ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo༞ laṃ tsaṇḍa lī na maḥ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo༞ ḍaṃ ḍoṃ bī nī na maḥ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa/ zhes sogs brjod cing zhal phyag rnams sgrub thabs ltar gsal btab la/ lha thams cad mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar bsam mo/

/de nas man ngag lugs la skabs 'dir/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ zhes sogs kyis skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ spro na spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs tshig bcad gcig gi mthar/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wan sa ma ya artsa ma na arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ pra titstsha pu dza no pa tsarya pra siddhi me zhes brjod la/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod bstod byas te dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sogs dang / bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod cing gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /zhes sogs gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rnam par snang mdzad/ yum dang gau rī dang pukka sī la mi bskyod pa/ zhes sogs kyis rgyas btab/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang bsdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam la/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang chus gtor te mi gtsang ba dang nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdang bar bsam pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/

oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis blug gzar gyi mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ agna ye ā dī byā dī bya/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul la/ skabs 'dir mchod bstod rgyas pa byed par bshad kyang phyag len la gong bdag bskyed kyi mjug tu bshad pa ltar phyi nang yid las byung ba dang / bstod pa'i mchod pa tsam mdzad pas lag len bde'o/ /de nas yam shing nas brtsams te sreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar de wa pi tsu tshar gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang / mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa 'bul dgos pas/ 'dir skabs gong 'og gi bcu gcig tshan gnyis la so so'i rdzas sngags kyis 'bul zhing / bar skabs kyi bcu gcig tshan rnams de wa pi tsu 'ba' zhig gis 'bul ba phyag len lags/ logs nas sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs rdzas rnams grangs bcu gcig 'bul ba ni/ gcig kha skong ba yin pas/ grangs ni bcu'i bar so so la bzung zhing / bcu gcig pa'i skabs su 'bul ba bandha lags zhes brjod/ bzung la bsnyen pa kha gso ba la sogs pa'i dus su/ de wa pi tsu stong phrag gcig bgrang ba dang bstun snod cig tu g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis til gsog cing grangs song ba dang 'bul/ de nas slar yang yam shing la sogs pa gong ltar 'bul ba dang / de wa pi tsu stong phrag bgrang ba sogs pa lan bcu'i bar du byas pas/ thun re la sngags khri tsho re 'gro zhing / de ltar thun bzhir byas pas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg 'grub pa ste/ gsang sngags 'bum phrag gcig la ni/

/sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /'dir ni de wa pi tsu la grangs bzung ba ni/ gong du snying po la bzhi 'bum gyi bsnyen pa byas pas de'i bcu cha la dgongs te/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched kyi phyag len thun mong ma yin pa yin zhing / sa lo tsā bas kyang rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed las/ grangs ni rdzas til lam yungs kar gang rung / sngags kī la ya kho nas grangs bzung bar gsungs shing / rje btsun e wam̐ pa rnams kyang / kun rig gi skabs su rtsa rig gam bskyed sngags la grangs bzung bar gsungs shing / mi 'khrugs pa'i skabs kaṃ ka ni la grangs bzung bar gsungs la/ yang e waṃ pa rnams kyai rdo rje'i sbyin sreg skabs/ grangs til sngags la 'dzin par mdzad pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su snying po la bzhi 'bum gyi grangs ma bzung ba dang / rtsa sngags la bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin mi thub pa la dgongs pa 'dra snyam mo/ /gang ltar sgrub g.yog gcig gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyis bud shing yang 'jug go /de la yam shing ni me 'od 'bar ba la/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha thams cad kyi zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam mo/ /sreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang / gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ byin gyis brlabs te phyi'i mchod pa rnams/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa tshig bcad sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ nang mchod kyi phud nas blangs te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sogs bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang / yi dam so so la phul/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma la bar phud phul/ lhag ma chos skyong dang 'byung po dang rigs drug la sogs pa'ang mchod la/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bo mchod par bsam ste bdud rtsi cung zad lce la myangs la/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas lha mo brgyad kyi mchod dkar mo ri dwags/ pa dang / bstod thung khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs/ dang / bstod phyag len la nyi shu pa mdzad/ ring la sogs pa ci shes pa bya/ 'das pa'i gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad ces sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i gtor bsngo dbang chu mdzes rgyan ltar byas la/ bde mchog dang gur nyi ma bar pa'i snga thun rjes su gtor bsngo 'bring po mdzad/ zhal la sogs pa'i gtor bsngo rgyas spro na skabs 'dir bskang gso yang mdzad/ pa/ de'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi bar byas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ skabs 'dir yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs nas/ lha brgyad la sogs pa'i rten med na brtan bzhugs bya mi dgos shing / lha brgyad rang la bsdu'o/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gtor bsngo bzhin byas la/ gur nas bshad pa'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra muḥ zhes dang / mtheb srin gyis se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam la/ srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa rjes la/ me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma gtang / /'dod don zhus la gshegs gsol lhag chad bskang / /las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste drug yin no/ /dang po me lha mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blug gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas blugs la/

oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsam la/ sreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blug gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed na/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg phul ba'i mthar/ bdag gam yon bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i nad dang gdon dang bkra mi shis pa dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shintiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma gcig bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / nang mchod/ lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa rnams gong bzhin bya/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags sgrub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghu sbi bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/

/zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ gsum pa ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba gong ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad bsgyur te/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs la/ oṃ prokṣa ṇaṃ pra tītstsha swāhās bsang gtor dang / oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha na swāhās 'thor 'thung phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis sgrub kyi gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agna ye gatstsha zhes dang / dbyug gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ skye mched drug dang gnas gsum bsrung ste/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci shes pa bya'o/ /sbyin sreg mi thub tshe sngags kyi grangs song nas/ yar ngo'i tshes gang yang rung ba'i gza' skar bzang ba zhig gi snga thun grol rjes dang / sbyin sreg byed tshe nyi ma gsum pa'i thun rjes sam/ sang nyin snga dro gtang rag gi tshul du gtor ma gsar pa bshams shing / bskang gso bkram bskang ngam bsdus bskang / rgyas bsdus mi shes na ma byas kyang rung mod/ ji ltar rigs pa byas la/ spyi btabs kyis gtor ma sgrub khang steng du phul nas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor la sogs pa mjug chog rnams grub rjes/ mtshams tho bsdus la dga' ston rgya chen pos thams cad tshim par bya ba ste gzhi'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gsal bar bshad zin to/ /drug pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa yin na/ me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la gnas dben par bskyal/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags la thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/

me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis par bya'o/ /e ma zab don snyan brgyud gser ri'i rtser/ /legs bshad 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzi brjid 'dis/ /log smra 'ug pa'i mig 'bras zil mnan nas/ /thub bstan gling bzhi mdzes par byed 'di mtshar/ /zhes pa dpal kyai rdo rje'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa bya tshul sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag len dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bla ma gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rnams kyi gsung rab la brten cing / khyad par glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub dang / thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i bsnyen thabs/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gsal ba'i me long rnams la gzhi byas shing / de dag tu mi gsal ba rnams snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can sku mched kyis rang nyid lo bcu gcig lon skabs byas gyur du gzhi bsnyen byas dus dang sbyin sreg gi tshe dngos dang brgyud pa'i bka' bkod phyag bris ngos ma rnams rim pa bzhin phebs pa'i gsung rgyun phyag len dang bcas pa ma nyams pas legs par brgyan te/ dus ngan gyi skye bo thos bsam dang mi ldan zhing / bla ma slob dpon sogs la gtugs pa'i bslab sbyangs dang bral zhing bza' chog don du gnyer te bsnyen song gi ming 'dod pa'i gang zag du mas lag len bag chol du spyod pa mang du mthong nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa snying nas ma bzod cing / khyad par rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la sogs te rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te 'brug gi lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu bzhi/ sngon bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi ta dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang /

rje btsun mus pa chen po buddha'i mtshan can rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sa skya pa za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo bcu phrag bzhi dang nyag ma bzhir slebs pa'i tshe/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi bkra shis brtsegs su legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyi bgyis so/ /'dis kyang bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 30 a myes zhabs/ dpal kye rdo rje'i bsnyen pa bya tshul zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 31
